meta.purpose: Single-topic local verification pack for the existing Topic Learning backend models and F01 catalog/detail flow.
meta.note: This pack follows the current BE model/VO shape in fix/topic-live-catalog. Top-level _id values are converted to BSON ObjectId by the importer; reference fields remain strings to match current model serialization. This differs from the illustrative ObjectId reference types in topic-learning-schema-v1.json and should be reconciled before generalizing this pack.
media_blockers: No confirmed project-hosted UK/US vocabulary pronunciation assets were found in the inspected repository sources.
Vocabulary audio_en_url/audio_us_url and optional cover/dialogue audio are null rather than fabricated URLs. Business rules require UK/US audio for publish-ready vocabulary content.

topics.title_en: At the Café: My First Order
topics.title_vi: Gọi món ở quán cà phê lần đầu
topics.description: Learn to greet café staff, choose a drink and size, order a snack, and pay politely. Học cách chào hỏi, chọn đồ uống và kích cỡ, gọi món ăn nhẹ, rồi thanh toán lịch sự.

topic_item_versions.title: Say Hello and Ask for the Menu
